sourceRegistry.title: Asana cuts model costs 76x in browser tests with GPT-6.1 Sol
sourceRegistry.factSummary: OpenAI describes Asana testing an optimized browser-agent workflow. The reported cost and speed improvements compare particular tested setups; they are not a guarantee for every browser task.

sourceRegistry.title: Sanas Introduces Supervised AI, Putting a Human at the Helm of Every AI Customer Conversation
sourceRegistry.factSummary: In its October 8 announcement, Sanas describes AI handling customer calls while a human supervisor monitors them and can intervene. This describes the company’s announced design, not independently verified service quality.

concepts.title: A polite request with momken
concepts.explanation: Momken before a verb makes a request: “could you…?” Teʿeed addresses one man; teʿeedi addresses one woman. Momken ashrah asks “may I explain?” Learn the person-specific verb forms as short chunks.

concepts.title: Say what you need
concepts.explanation: A female speaker says mehtaaga, while a male speaker says mehtaag. Both mean “needing / I need” in these examples. Put mosaaʿda after it. Mesh before an adjective negates a description; no separate present-tense “is” is needed.

lessons.title: Kitöltöm az űrlapot
lessons.subtitle: October 9, 2026 · A form, a field and a name
objectives: Describe a form and an empty field.
Say what you open and fill out.
Say whether something is ready yet.

sentences.english: Asana tested an AI tool.

sentences.text: A tesztben az új változat gyorsabb és olcsóbb volt.
sentences.english: In the test, the new version was faster and cheaper.

sentences.text: Az eredmény erre a tesztre vonatkozik.
sentences.english: The result applies to this test.
Anna: I open the page.
Bence: Where is the form?
Anna: Here it is.
Bence: This field is empty.
Anna: I enter a name.
Bence: Now I fill out the form.
Anna: Is the form ready?
Bence: It is not ready yet.
Anna: Which field is empty?
Bence: This field.
Anna: I check the data.
Bence: Good, now it is ready.

concepts.title: Open it; fill it out
concepts.explanation: Megnyitom and kitöltöm are complete forms for “I open it” and “I fill it out”. With a specific object, use the definite article and the object ending: az oldalt, az űrlapot. Beírok egy nevet uses an unspecified “a name”; név changes to nevet.

concepts.title: Not ready yet; ready now
concepts.explanation: Még nem kész means “not ready yet”. Most már kész means “now it is ready”, marking a change. In these third-person present descriptions, Hungarian has no separate word for “is”. The same pattern works for an empty field.
